title: Leah Remini Joins ‘The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills’ Season 16
description: Season 16 of “The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” has a new marquee star: The Bravo show has landed actor/anti-Scientology activist Leah Remini as
body:
Season 16 of “The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” has a new marquee star: The Bravo show has landed actor/anti-Scientology activist Leah Remini as a full-time cast member.

	Remini won’t be the only new cast member on “RHOBH.” Tracy Tutor, the real estate agent and former “Million Dollar Listing Los Angeles” star announced on Instagram on Aug. 19 that she’s also joining the cast. Remini and Tutor will co-star with returning full-time cast members Kyle Richards, Erika “Jayne” Girardi, Dorit Kemsley, Bozoma Saint John, Rachel Zoe and Sutton Stracke. Kathy Hilton and Jennifer Tilly will also be back as “friends” of the cast. Amanda Frances — the manifesting guru added to the cast for its 15th season — was not asked back, despite Rihanna’s DM to Frances saying, “We need more of you!” Frances herself announced her own departure on Instagram on Aug. 5.
	

	Season 16 has already begun filming, with several of the cast (though not Remini and Tutor) attending Boz’s wedding to Keely Watson in Ghana on Aug. 21. Dorit, Kyle, Jennifer and Sutton were among the guests.


	“The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills” is the most-watched edition of the “Real Housewives” franchise, which turned 20 this year. Within segments of the Bravosphere, it’s also the most complained about, with quibbling fans constantly calling for a major cast overhaul, year after year. As executive producer Andy Cohen put it sarcastically in an interview with Variety in June, “They hate it so much, it’s the No. 1 ‘Housewives.'” Now, with eight full-time cast members and two veteran (and popular) friends, perhaps this full deck of Housewives will tamp down the griping. It will certainly put an end to the rampant (and incorrect) speculation about the Season 16 cast, which has included an anonymous tip to DeuxMoi claiming that Kyle had filmed a farewell scene during production on “Real Housewives Ultimate Girls Trip Roaring 20th” and a blind item sent to Bravo and Cocktails that said Dorit was being put on pause. (Executive producer Alex Baskin debunked the Dorit report, which had spread far and wide.) There was also speculation that Crystal Kung Minkoff, who was on Seasons 11-13, might rejoin the cast, especially after she was featured on “Ultimate Girls Trip.”
	

	Remini and Tutor’s new associates are a divided group — Season 15 concluded in May after a fiery three-part reunion, during which the tension between Kyle and Dorit, who were once close friends, boiled over. Dorit’s divorce from Paul “PK” Kemsley has continued to make headlines over the summer, with both of them accusing the other of financial mayhem, with their school-age children stuck in the middle.

	Remini, 56, became a household name during the nine-season-long run of “King of Queens” on CBS. In 2015, she released the memoir “Troublemaker: Surviving Hollywood and Scientology,” in which she recounted her rise in Hollywood as well as her indoctrination into Scientology beginning at age 9. (“Where is Shelly?” Remini has asked since 2006, wondering about the whereabouts of Shelly Miscavige, the never-seen wife of Scientology leader David Miscavige). Remini’s high-profile exit from the organization caused her to become an anti-cult crusader, and she and fellow ex-Scientologist Mike Rinder hosted “Leah Remini: Scientology and the Aftermath” on A&E, winning two primetime Emmys for the series along the way.

	As for Tutor, 51, she’s no stranger to Bravo. As a successful real estate agent, Tutor starred on the network’s long-running show “Million Dollar Listing Los Angeles” from Seasons 10 through 15, before it was put on pause last year. Tutor has long seemed to fans like an obvious choice to join “RHOBH,” and on her Instagram post, Cohen wrote, “This has been a long time coming!”

schema.headline: Leah Remini Joins ‘The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills’ Season 16

title: Beyoncé Announces $1 Million Donation for Earthquake Relief Efforts in Colombia
description: Beyoncé has announced that she will make a personal donation of $1 million to support relief efforts in Colombia following the country’s recent eart
body:
Beyoncé has announced that she will make a personal donation of $1 million to support relief efforts in Colombia following the country’s recent earthquake.

	According to a release from Parkwood Entertainment on Tuesday, the donation will provide food and housing supplies to areas most affected by the 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck Chocó, Colombia, on August 10. The release encourages those who can help to visit websites for Food For the Poor and World Central Kitchen.
	

	At least 312 people were killed in the earthquake earlier this month, according to AP, and 29,000 homes were destroyed. According to the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs, 69,000 people in Chocó — or about 10 percent of its population — were affected or displaced by the earthquake.


	Beyoncé joins a growing list of musicians who are raising and donating money for earthquake relief in recent weeks. Shakira, a Colombian native, met with Chocó’s governor and mayor to hear about the impact of the earthquake and committed $1.25 million to help rebuild affected schools. That sum included $500,000 from the FIFA Global Citizen Education Fund, a $500,000 match from the Fund from Live Nation, and $250,000 from CAF.

	“These past few days, I’ve watched my country suffer, but I’ve also watched people come together with the resilience and solidarity that has always defined us,” said Shakira in a statement. “Schools are more than buildings. They give children the stability and routine they need most after a disaster. That’s why we’re making an initial $1.25 million commitment to help rebuild schools and get children back into their classrooms. Chocó is not alone. Colombia is not alone. And we will keep going.”
	

	Additionally, Karol G donated $1.2 million to earthquake victims through her foundation, while the Colombian band Morat announced that they will donate a portion of ticket sales from their Bogotá residency.

schema.headline: Beyoncé Announces $1 Million Donation for Earthquake Relief Efforts in Colombia

title: Jon Stewart, Bruce Springsteen and Hasan Minhaj to Perform at New York’s Stand Up for Heroes Event
description:
Bruce Springsteen, Jon Stewart and Hasan Minhaj will headline the 20th annual Stand Up for Heroes event in New York City.

	The variety show, taking
body:
Bruce Springsteen, Jon Stewart and Hasan Minhaj will headline the 20th annual Stand Up for Heroes event in New York City.

	The variety show, taking place at Lincoln Center on Nov. 9 as part of the New York Comedy Festival, doubles as a fundraiser for the Bob Woodruff Foundation, which has raised $117 million for veterans, military families and caregivers since the inaugural Stand Up for Heroes in 2007.


	The lineup also includes a comedy set from Josh Johnson and musical performances from the Resilient and Alex Warren. Tickets are available for purchase here.
	

	“Twenty years ago we put together Stand Up for Heroes with a simple idea: bring people together with laughter and music in honor of those who have sacrificed so much for our country,” said Bob Woodruff, ABC News Correspondent and co-founder of the Bob Woodruff Foundation. “When we started this way back in 2007 we thought it would just be a one-time concert. But it’s become one of the most meaningful nights of the year. Think about that! Right there in the theater veterans and service members share the spotlight with unforgettable tributes by world-class performers. Those who come to the show will ensure that men and women serving today will not be left behind tomorrow. I look forward to taking the stage again as we celebrate how far we’ve come and as we renew our promise to always have the backs of the next generation of American heroes.”

	Added Caroline Hirsch, founder and owner of the New York Comedy Festival: “For 20 years, we have brought together the extraordinary worlds of comedy, music and the military community for one unforgettable night to honor those who have sacrificed so much. Stand Up for Heroes began with an idea we developed with Bob and Lee Woodruff, and what started as a single night has grown into a powerful and enduring tradition. We are incredibly proud of the event we created and everything we have built together over the past two decades, and as we celebrate this milestone, we look forward to continuing to honor our heroes and share their stories for years to come.”

schema.headline: Jon Stewart, Bruce Springsteen and Hasan Minhaj to Perform at New York’s Stand Up for Heroes Event

title: James Gunn Says ‘Superman: Man of Tomorrow’ Has Wrapped Filming: ‘I Have Immense Gratitude’
description:
“Superman: Man of Tomorrow” is one step closer to soaring into theaters. 

	Writer and director James Gunn revealed on Threads that “Superman: Man o
body:
“Superman: Man of Tomorrow” is one step closer to soaring into theaters. 

	Writer and director James Gunn revealed on Threads that “Superman: Man of Tomorrow” has officially wrapped filming. 

	“That’s a wrap on principal photography for ‘Man of Tomorrow,’” Gunn wrote in his post, accompanied by two photographs with the crew. “Truly a joyful experience and I have immense gratitude to my cast and crew. First photo: [Nicholas Hoult] jumped in the lake after last shot. Second photo: The brain trust (except Brian) around video village during the whole shoot. They make making movies fun.”
	

	“Superman: Man of Tomorrow” is the sequel to 2025’s “Superman,” with David Corenswet returning as the Man of Steel. In the sequel, Superman is forced to team up with his adversary Lex Luthor (Nicholas Hoult) as they work to defeat an even bigger threat: the super-intelligent antagonist Brainiac (Lars Eidinger).


	Rachel Brosnahan is back as Lois Lane. Other returning cast members include Skyler Gisondo as Jimmy Olsen, Sara Sampaio as Eve Teschmacher, Isabela Merced as Hawkgirl, Nathan Fillion as Guy Gardner and Edi Gathegi as Mister Terrific. Milly Alcock, who had a cameo as Superman’s cousin Kara Zor-El, returns for “Man of Tomorrow” after headlining this summer’s DC tentpole “Supergirl.” The sequel will also introduce Aaron Pierre to the big screen as John Stewart, who is debuting in the HBO Max series “Lanterns.”

	The showdown will hit theaters on July 9, 2027, but Gunn has kept fans up to date on social media in the meantime. He first indicated on Instagram on April 20 that filming had begun with a photo of a “Luther, A” badge, a chessboard and a bag of Ruffles chips. A few months later, on June 1, he unveiled a sneak peek of Luther’s war suit with the caption “Fit check. Live from the set of Man of Tomorrow.”

schema.headline: James Gunn Says ‘Superman: Man of Tomorrow’ Has Wrapped Filming: ‘I Have Immense Gratitude’

title: ITV Boss is Hopeful As Acquisition Looms: ‘Sky Wouldn’t Be Buying Us for All That Money if They Wanted To Rip Us Apart’
description: As U.K. public service broadcaster ITV prepares to be swallowed up by Comcast-owned Sky (the pact still needs to clear regulators, which could take
body:
As U.K. public service broadcaster ITV prepares to be swallowed up by Comcast-owned Sky (the pact still needs to clear regulators, which could take up to a year), managing director Kevin Lygo is staying positive.

	“I think everybody understands the logic of it and why it’s such a good idea and a good deal,” said Lygo, speaking at the Edinburgh TV Festival on Wednesday. “But there’s uncertainty, and everybody gets a bit worried about uncertainty.”
	

	One of the prime reasons for that uncertainty, Lygo explained, was that as part of the legal process underpinning the deal, neither side can talk about what will happen if and when it finally closes – including what it impact it will have on jobs. “Neither Sky nor us [can] talk about individuals or what the merger will do,” he said.


	Until the day the deal closes, ITV “will continue as we are now to run our business completely separate from Sky,” Lygo said. With that expected to take up to a year, Lygo said ITV’s commissioning strategy for 2027 and “most of” 2028 would remain unchanged.

	When asked whether he thought the deal was likely to slow down commissioning, Lygo sidestepped the question, saying: “Everything has so dramatically changed just in the last few years that scale, as everyone talks about, is important and really you need to be bigger, you need to be funded in a significant and continuing manner, and I think what the deal with Sky will do is underpin what we need to continue doing what we do that really matters.”

	He pointed out that Sky will need to adhere to ITV’s PSB license throughout its term, which currently runs until 2034, including all the “regulatory constrictions and promises of that.” That includes commitments to news and independent production spend outside of London.
	

	Lygo is hopeful that the broadcaster will remain intact beyond the term of its license. “We’ll have to wait and see,” he said. “But Sky wouldn’t be buying us for all that money if they wanted to rip us apart and destroy us and change what we are and so forth. So I think you’ll see gradual changes, probably changes backstage you don’t even notice.”

schema.headline: ITV Boss is Hopeful As Acquisition Looms: ‘Sky Wouldn’t Be Buying Us for All That Money if They Wanted To Rip Us Apart’

title: X Launches ‘NFL Gametime,’ a Football Feed Placed Alongside ‘For You’ and ‘Following’
description:
X will really mark the spot for NFL content.

	The social-media outlet is launching “NFL Gametime,” a new project that offers an NFL feed weaving da
body:
X will really mark the spot for NFL content.

	The social-media outlet is launching “NFL Gametime,” a new project that offers an NFL feed weaving data, news and creators into the overall user experience. X users can choose to put the new topic-focused stream alongside mainstay feeds like “For You” and “Following.” The stream will be available from season kickoff through the end of the 2027 Super Bowl. The move is seen not only as a way to court sports fans, but also big advertisers that may have felt more ambivalent about working with the Elon Musk-backed social giant in months past.
	

	The NFL feed also features a “GameTime” hub, a static element in the NFL timeline that features real-time scores and statistics alongside the gridiron conversation. X and the NFL have had an alliance in place since 2013, and in the interim have tested concepts that have included audio and sponsored “Spaces,” the live conversations that take place outside the service’s mainstream feeds. 


	 “Advertisers can now reach highly passionate fans across the entire funnel, from awareness and cultural conversation to real-time engagement during live games, all on X,” said Monique Pintarelli, who heads up global advertising for X parent SpaceXAI, in a statement. “Together with the NFL, we’re giving brands a powerful, authentic way to show up throughout the season.”

	X in July settled a lawsuit Musk levied in 2024 against the World Federation of Advertisers, an industry organization, alleging a “systematic illegal boycott” of his social platform after he purchased it for $44 billion in 2022. Advertisers, who often redirect marketing dollars away from platforms where their support might become controversial, became wary of the entrepreneur’s unfettered musings on politics and culture. Among the marketers alleged by X to have participated in a boycott were Mars, CVS Health, Shell and Lego. A federal court dismissed the lawsuit in March.
	

	 X and WFA reached a settlement in July and said the deal “resets the relationship between the two organizations,” with both agreeing ” brands, platforms and consumers will all benefit from brand-safety innovation.”

	The new stream of NFL content would seem to bolster those vows. The new feed features posts by top football journalists and columnists, as well as some of the industry’s top commentators and hosts. A recent scroll though the feed found comments from ESPN’s Pat McAfee and Mina Kimes; Cleveland.com Browns reporter Mary Kay Cabot; NFL spokesman Brian McCarthy; and The Athletic’s Jonathan Jones.

	Executives, citing research they say shows two out of three U.S. X users are NFL fans,  believe the new NFL feed will open a bevy of opportunities for sponsors who want to align themselves with conversations tied to the sport. The new feed is “fully discoverable across every surface fans already use,” X says.

	“For years, X has been a key platform for NFL fans to connect, react and engage around every NFL moment,” said Brent Lawton, the NFL’s vice president of media strategy and business development, said in a statement. “We’re excited to deepen our partnership with NFL Gametime on X, allowing our fans to have official scores and stats, team content, and the conversation together in one place.”

schema.headline: X Launches ‘NFL Gametime,’ a Football Feed Placed Alongside ‘For You’ and ‘Following’

title: Oscars: Chile Picks Manuela Martelli’s ‘The Meltdown’ for the International Feature Race
description: Chile’s Film Academy has selected “The Meltdown” (“El deshielo”) by Manuela Martelli, her post-Pinochet mystery drama set in an Andes ski resort, to
body:
Chile’s Film Academy has selected “The Meltdown” (“El deshielo”) by Manuela Martelli, her post-Pinochet mystery drama set in an Andes ski resort, to represent the country in the Best International Feature category at the 2027 Academy Awards. Martelli’s follow-up to her acclaimed drama “Chile, 1976” had its world premiere at Cannes’ prominent strand Un Certain Regard this year.

	Said Gabriel Díaz, president of the Chilean Academy: “These have been days of watching excellent national premieres. For the first time in history, half of the submitted films were directed by women, which speaks to an industry that is modernizing and evolving healthily.”
	

	“All received state support and the vast majority are international co-productions, which has boosted the multiplier effect of the audiovisual industry in various sectors of the national economy,” she added.

	News comes not long after Mubi announced it was picking up Latin American streaming rights to the drama and the not so welcome news that Chile’s Audiovisual Investment Support Fund had been slashed by 64%. Díaz called on Chile’s Ministry of Cultures, Arts and Heritage, which saw an overall 9% cut to its 2027 budget by the administration of new President Jose Antonio Kast, to “strengthen the Audiovisual Fund, without censorship or prejudice.”

	“The Meltdown” stars Maya O’Rourke – in her film debut – who plays a nine-year-old at her family’s ski resort who witnesses unsettling events that will test her loyalties. Other cast members are Paulina Urrutia, Mauricio Pešutić, Paula Zúñiga, Marcela Salinas and Lautaro Cantillana.
	

	Written and directed by Martelli, with cinematography by Benjamín Echazarreta, the film is a Chilean-American-Mexican-Spanish co-production involving leading players Ronda Cine, U.S.-based Cinema Inutile, Wood Producciones, Elástica Films, Piano and Fundación Río. Les Films du Losange handles international sales.

	U.S. distributor Kino Lorber is planning a theatrical release.

	Chile’s selection now advances to the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences, which will pare down the full slate of submissions to a shortlist of 15 films before announcing five nominees on Dec. 15 and the final five on Jan. 21. The 99th Academy Awards ceremony will be held on March 14, 2027.

schema.headline: Oscars: Chile Picks Manuela Martelli’s ‘The Meltdown’ for the International Feature Race

title: Why Lionsgate Vet’s Saudi Arabia-Backed Game Studio Picked ‘1,001 Arabian Nights’ Adaptation as Its Debut Title
description: When it comes to picking IP that’s prime for adaptation, it’s hard to find a story — or rather, stories — with more staying power than “One Thousand
body:
When it comes to picking IP that’s prime for adaptation, it’s hard to find a story — or rather, stories — with more staying power than “One Thousand and One Nights.” 

	During video game trade event Gamescom‘s Opening Night Live presentation in Germany Tuesday, new Saudi Arabia-backed developer MBC Game Studio unveiled its first project, “1001 Threads of Mazin,” an action-adventure game set within the world of the iconic collection of Arabic folk tales best known as “Arabian Nights” to the English-speaking world. 
	

	From creative director Lars Bonde, the game utilizes the classic frame story featuring the ruler Shahryar being told one story a night by his wife Scheherazade, as she attempts to stay her execution. 


	But rather than lead with legends like Aladdin, Ali Baba and Sinbad, “1001 Threads of Mazin” will shift the famous storyweaver focus to three new characters and unlikely heroes — Yusra, Malik and Sufyan — as they attempt to rediscover the lost power of the Mizan in a quest to take down an ancient jinn king before his thirst for vengeance destroys humanity.

	“From day one, one of the things that was really important to us was ‘1,001 Arabian Nights’ has been around for a long time, and it is not a singular story, it’s a collection of stories and it’s a collection of stories that were built that was taken up over years,” MBC Game Studio CEO Daniel Engelhardt tells Variety. “The oral storytelling tradition in the region is just incredible, and so we looked at it as really a launching off pad, not just we’re only going to tell the story of ‘1,001 Arabian Nights,’ but it’s a chance to tap into Arabic folklore more broadly.”
	

	Per the game’s description, “It’s a journey made to be shared: built for up to three players with drop-in, dropout co-op, you and your friends can take to the skies on flying carpets to bring down jinn of colossal scale together. The flying carpet traversal and gameplay system is at the heart of ‘1001 Threads of Mizan’ and allows players to fly through the world, delivering a sense of adventure, speed and possibility that opens up a world of storytelling and gameplay opportunities.”

	Backed by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund-owned MBC Group, “1001 Threads of Mazin” maker MBC Game Studio led by Engelhardt, a former gaming exec for Lionsgate, and COO Trevor Williams. While made up of a global team of developers — vets from BioWare, Hi-Rez, Ubisoft Montréal, Bungie and more game studios — the “Threads of Mazin” leadership team has put a particular emphasis on hiring Arabic developers, folklore experts and actors to work on the project.

	“Some of the first hires that we made were on the folklore side of the equation, and really being able to deeply understand that,” Engelhardt says. “One of our heads of folklore, she’s from the region, was educated there. She did get her master’s at UC Berkeley. The other person who leads that department is a literary PhD, a literary historian who quite literally was teaching classes on ‘1,001 Arabian Nights’ at UCLA when we met him. So it’s like really just an incredible encyclopedia.”

	Engelhardt adds: “We don’t have the creator of ‘1,001 Arabian Nights,’ there wasn’t a singular creator, and they certainly wouldn’t be around today. So the best way to get to it was to really build a team and make them central to the development process. So they aren’t consultants; they’re part of the design team. They’re within the world and narrative team, and they play a material role in shaping the vision for the game across the mechanics, the world, the narrative, art, everything. That was a fundamental building block.” 

	This method extended to the actual game designers, who Engelhardt says made suggestions that affected the game’s story, in addition to its aesthetic and gameplay: “Some of the earliest hires were artists in the region. They have contributed incredibly meaningfully to the project. In the demo, you’ll see a fallen jinn. That was a concept that came from one of our artists in the region who said, OK, well, if there’s been centuries of battles between an evil jinn faction and humanity, perhaps some pieces of them would still remain in the world? And then they took it even a step further and said, you lose your jinn magic, and that’s taken up within that.”
	

	Though the team is not yet ready to reveal its cast, Engelhardt says the “1001 Threads of Mazin” trailer featuring a voice-over from Shahrazad was acted out by a native Arabic speaker, and that is the standard being set for the game’s casting process.

	“Anyone who is in the game will be an Arabic speaker who’s both doing the English and Arabic versions,” Engelhardt says. “This has been particularly meaningful to us as we’ve been developing the project, because when we do casting sessions and the actors come in to audition, we’re telling their story, right? They’re coming in and seeing this story that we’re telling that represents lore that they’ve heard from their grandparents or uncles or aunts and so it means a lot to them when they see that. And we’ve seen pretty tremendous emotional responses. When you’re working on a project for this long, it’s nice when you get those touch points of motivation. We’re like, oh, this is an exciting project that we believe will appeal globally or around the world, but to be able to have in the region that kind of resonance and that kind of emotional response is really exciting to us.”

	While no release date has been set for “1001 Threads of Mizan,” which is being developed for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC, MBC is already bullish on early marketing by offering hands-on demos for consumers, press and content creators on the show floor at Gamescom this week.

	See the announcement trailer in the video below.

schema.headline: Why Lionsgate Vet’s Saudi Arabia-Backed Game Studio Picked ‘1,001 Arabian Nights’ Adaptation as Its Debut Title

title: Dolly Parton Streams Surge on Spotify With 2,320% Increase in the United States
description: Dolly Parton’s music has significantly surged on Spotify following her death on Tuesday, with total streams increasing over 1,260% globally and 2,32
body:
Dolly Parton’s music has significantly surged on Spotify following her death on Tuesday, with total streams increasing over 1,260% globally and 2,320% in the United States compared to the prior seven-day daily average.

	The country icon saw substantial boosts across her catalog after her death was announced. “Jolene” increased 630% globally and 1,225% in the U.S., compared to the prior seven-day daily average, while “9 to 5” increased 620% globally and 1,030% in the U.S. and “Islands in the Stream” increased 525% globally and 1,235% in the United States. “Jolene” was the most-shared Parton song on Spotify, followed by “I Will Always Love You” and “Islands in the Stream.”
	

	Additionally, seven songs broke into Spotify’s Daily Top Songs USA chart, with “Jolene” and “9 to 5” entering for the first time at Nos. 2 and 3, respectively. “Jolene” received 1.29 million streams, while “9 to 5” received 1.13 million streams. On that same chart, “Islands in the Stream” reentered at No. 8 (885,000), followed by “I Will Always Love You” at No. 15 (688,000), “Here You Come Again” at No. 28 (566,000), “Coat of Many Colors” (516,000) at No. 34 and “Tyrant” at No. 189.


	Parton’s family announced her death on Tuesday. Representatives for the singer revealed that she died after a “brief battle” with cancer at Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville.

	“Our beloved Dolly Parton spent her life and career bringing joy, laughter, hope and integrity into everything she touched. Her unmatched generosity reached the lives of countless people whom she would never meet, yet she was always there to offer a helping hand,” the statement from her reps to People magazine read.

schema.headline: Dolly Parton Streams Surge on Spotify With 2,320% Increase in the United States

title: ‘The Witcher’ Co-Producer Rae Benjamin to Receive Starz #TakeTheLead Award at Humanitas Event, Presented by Russell T Davies
description: “The Witcher” Season 5 co-producer Rae Benjamin, who is also the cowriter of the animated feature “The Witcher: Sirens of the Deep,” has been select
body:
“The Witcher” Season 5 co-producer Rae Benjamin, who is also the cowriter of the animated feature “The Witcher: Sirens of the Deep,” has been selected to receive this year’s Starz #TakeTheLead award at the Humanitas Prizes awards show and toast next month, one of several honors the org revealed on Wednesday.

	Benjamin will be presented the award by screenwriter/producer Russell T Davies (“Doctor Who,” “Queer As Folk,” “Years and Years”), who’s behind the upcoming Starz series “Tip Toe.” The recipient is chosen among “mid-career writers” who exemplify the promise to “amplify narratives by, about and for women and underrepresented audiences.” As part of the prize, Benjamin will receive a $10,000 cash prize and mentorship from Starz executives.
	

	“Rae Benjamin stood out immediately for her distinctive voice and fearless approach to storytelling,” said Starz original programming prexy Kathryn Busby in a statement. “We were equally impressed by her commitment to supporting emerging voices through her organization, In The Cut, which reflects the spirit of #TakeTheLead and Starz’s commitment to elevating underrepresented storytellers. Rae’s talent, curiosity, and commitment to meaningful storytelling will take her far, and it’s easy to see why she was selected as this year’s Starz #TakeTheLead Award recipient.”


	Other finalists included Autumn Jimerson (“Forever”), William Yu (“The ‘Burbs”), Melody Cooper (“Power Book IV: Force”), Jonathon Roessler (“My Life with the Walter Boys”) and Sylvia Alcalá (“A Man on the Inside”).
	

	“Through my writing, volunteer work with emerging artists, and company, In the Cut, it’s been my goal to create expansive and positive representation for marginalized communities,” Benjamin said in a statement. “Humanitas and Starz are both organizations that go beyond the mere checkbox of inclusion for its own sake, but truly champion innovative storytelling. The 2026 #TakeTheLead Award’s prize money will help support my upcoming short film focused on Black maternal health.”

	As previously announced, “My So-Called Life” creator Winnie Holzman will receive this year’s Kieser Award. She’ll be presented the honor by “Thirtysomething” exec producers Marshall Herskovitz and Ed Zwick — who hired Holzman to be a writer on their show and later were EPs on “My So-Called Life.”

	Also announced Wednesday, Humanitas’s 2026-27 New Voices Fellows have been chosen: Christina Ingraldi, Leon Lee, Alana Saab, Finn Wagstaff and Keith Walker. As part of the fellowship, they’ll participate in a six-month mentorship program for early-career television and screenwriters, be paired with writers for one-on-one mentorship and receive a $7,500 stipend in addition to other benefits. Writer Emmylou Diaz is the fellowship’s Program Advisor.

	Humanitas shared its College Screenwriting Awards winners: Omid Iranikhah (David and Lynn Angell College Comedy Award) and Lauryn Bedford (Carol Mendelsohn College Drama Award). Bedford and Iranikhah will each receive a $20,000 cash prize and a script notes session with a professional writer. Humanitas program alums Lauren Goodman (“Snowfall”) and Hayley Tibbenham (“Dutton Ranch”) will present the artist development awards.

	As part of the New Voice Fellowship program, Humanitas has this year launched a partnership connecting fellows with managers from Echo Lake Entertainment for an educational exchange. 

	“At its heart, this partnership reflects a shared belief that developing writers require mentorship, community, and access to people invested in their growth. We are grateful to Echo Lake Entertainment for working with Humanitas to equip the next generation of writers exploring the human condition in their work by helping to illuminate pathways for their stories,” Humanitas Executive Director Michelle Franke said in a statement.
	

	Added Echo Lake partner Amy Schiffman: “We’re proud to be teaming up with Humanitas for this important initiative to support emerging writers. We envision this partnership as benefiting our management team as well as the New Voices Fellows.”

	The Humanitas Prizes Awards Show & Toast will be held on Sept. 9 at Avalon Hollywood and hosted by writer, actor and comedian Ashley Nicole Black.

schema.headline: ‘The Witcher’ Co-Producer Rae Benjamin to Receive Starz #TakeTheLead Award at Humanitas Event, Presented by Russell T Davies

Keke Palmer

                          It's My Smoking Hot Birthday!!!

title: 'MrChildPorn' Arrested For Allegedly Sharing Illicit Photos of Children
body:
'MrChildPorn'
                          Arrested on Child Porn Charge
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              August 26, 2026
                            1:40 PM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  August 26, 2026
                                2:29 PM PDT
                                    
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                                  
      
    
            If this West Virginia man thought reverse psychology would throw cops off his scent, he was mistaken ... because a dude who allegedly went by the name "MrChildPorn" online was arrested for possession of child porn.
      
    
            Garrett Michael Highlander -- a 20-year-old from Morgantown -- was arrested last week and charged with possession of material depicting minors engaged in sexually explicit conduct.
      
    
            West Virginia State Police allege Highlander used the names "MrChildPorn" and "MrToxix" online and bragged about a large cache of child porn ... and they say he allegedly used Discord to share child porn images.
      

            Law enforcement claims Highlander generally used variations of the name "MrToxix" -- though they also claim he "used the name MrChildPorn on one or more occasions."
      
    
                    
                          
                                  
      
        
    
            Highlander is also accused of attempting to use Discord's A.I. feature to search for explicit images of infants ... and "asked repeatedly if anyone was willing to trade 'cp' with him."
      
    
            According to cops, Highlander allegedly said he only made the statements to troll or rage bait others ... but police say they found explicit footage of children on his devices.
      
    
            Highlander was arrested and booked into the North Central Regional Jail. He was being held on a $100,000 bond.

            Chris Hansen is kicking his feud with A24 up a notch ... purchasing ad space before every showing of the Robert Pattinson flick about his Dateline sex predator show ... all to promote his new pedo-hunting project.
      
    
            Chris will use the ads to direct audiences to TruBlu ... his streaming network devoted to the child predator investigations that made him a pop culture staple, according to The Hollywood Reporter.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            It seems Chris was toying with the idea of capping each ad with a line about the movie being "a Hollywood fantasy version" of that time in his life ... but thought better of it when mulling potential legal action from A24, the studio behind the movie.
      

            Chris has made it clear he does not support the project ... and made a big stink about not being allowed to preview the film after he refused to sign an NDA.
      
    
            The TV personality said he was being asked to sign his life rights away ... but a source within the studio told TMZ it was a standard NDA -- and he had the option to suggest edits to the language. He didn't.
      
    
            Chris sent us part of the NDA.
      
    
                    
                          
                                  
      
        
    
            Seems like Chris and A24 will go back and forth ... asking each other to have a seat.

Miley Cyrus

                              August 26, 2026
                            11:26 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
            Miley Cyrus was spotted for the first time since her godmother Dolly Parton's death ... looking somber as she arrived at a Los Angeles recording studio.
      
    
            The singer donned shades and an all-black fit -- from her tee to her jeans to her shoes and her bag.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            It looks like Miley was gearing up to film something ... there's a mic clipped to her shirt collar, and she walked in with a man holding what appears to be a handheld piece of audio equipment.
      

            It's unclear what she may be filming.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Miley's mother, Tish Cyrus, was also snapped leaving the studio ... being driven away in a car.
      
    
            As you know ... Dolly died Tuesday at Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center in Nashville ... after a brief battle with cancer.
      
    
        Waiting for your permission to load the Instagram Media.
      
    
            Miley posted a heart-wrenching tribute to her godmother on Wednesday ... saying it would not feel right to express the depth of her feelings for Dolly in a public forum -- because sacred moments like the ones she cherished with Dolly are supposed to remain private.
      
    
            Still, Miley said Dolly would always be an angel watching over her.
      
    
            As we told you ... Dolly's death was a sudden shock to her loved ones, even though they knew she'd been sick.
      
    
            Dolly died on August 25 ... an "important" date in Miley's life and career to this point ... and now the date is taking on an even deeper meaning.
